purpose: Run the complete MRW frontend Linux gate set against one exact materialized preview without host service reuse, external network access, source mutation, or hidden environment fallback.

runner.runtime: Node.js 22 inside the admitted Linux image

codex_stub.claim_boundary: synthetic proxy, bootstrap, and iframe readiness only; no native Codex, user authentication, WebSocket, tool, chat, or session-control claim

network.runner_evidence_limit: The runner verifies a hash-bound external admission and its hash-bound negative-probe receipt against the exact run, source, preview, lifecycle, image, network name and ID, and security owner. Docker daemon inspection remains the external security owner's evidence.

planned_preview.predecessor_disposition: Attempt6 and its temporary root are historical diagnostic evidence only and must not be restored or reused.
planned_preview.boundary: A fresh persistent candidate manifest and materialized preview are required before execution. The manifest remains upstream evidence, not a substitute for the runner-algorithm frontend-preview-identity.v1 receipt.

mount_contract.content: exact self-contained materialized preview with reachable Git metadata
mount_contract.required_probe: exclusive write probe must fail with EROFS, EACCES, or EPERM

mount_contract.content: create-only per-run projection frontend-full-suite-${MRW_RUN_ID}; never reused or deleted by the runner
create-only logs, reports, snapshots, source-difference record, admission receipts, and shared DB sequencing lock
this external batch execution package; it is not candidate product source

execution_modes.static-only: Projects the image's already frozen-installed node_modules only after exact package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, and virtual-store-lock hash checks, then runs lint, typecheck, all 19 non-browser named static checks, build, Storybook static build, and all Storybook interactions under Docker --network none. This is image-bound dependency evidence, not a fresh candidate install. It does not require or start backend, stub, database, Redis, Elasticsearch, or the main Playwright suite.
execution_modes.full: Runs every ordered gate and requires exact preview identity, security-owner lifecycle admission, explicit service targets, seeded project key, and exclusive shared-DB lease.

required_fields.image_sha256: exact-match fresh MRW_IMAGE_ID_SHA256; predecessor e40af595... is rejected by the runner
required_fields.security_owner: exact-match fresh MRW_SECURITY_OWNER; predecessor v6_intake_v4_impl is rejected by the runner

backend_lifecycle_admission.reason: A prior lifecycle-enabled TestClient run emitted committed LLM-config upserts; backend startup is therefore fail-closed until the safety owner admits the exact image, preview, and database target.

external_security_admission.binding: The admission and referenced negative-probe receipt must exact-match the run ID, source commit/tree, preview identity, lifecycle admission, image SHA256, internal network name and ID, and security owner. Caller-supplied PASS strings are rejected.

shared_database_sequence.parallelism: No other database-mutating gate may overlap. Frontend Playwright uses one worker. Dynamic E2E projects are cleaned by their tests; the seeded real-business project is security-owner supplied.

offline_tool_binding.static_only_projection_checks: Exact-match candidate and image package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and pnpm-workspace.yaml hashes; exact-match node_modules/.pnpm/lock.yaml to candidate pnpm-lock.yaml; copy the full installed tree; reject any broken symlink. Static-only commands invoke the projected eslint, tsc, Vite, Storybook, and Playwright executables directly and invoke named Node scripts directly, so pnpm cannot reinterpret or mutate the image-installed projection. The external narrow pnpm router preserves the package-script prefixes storybook -> storybook dev -p 6006 --host 0.0.0.0 and dev -> vite, forwards appended argv, and is self-tested with dev delimiter/help forwarding, Storybook dev/help forwarding, and an exact rejected install route before Playwright may use it.
offline_tool_binding.reason: Use the image-prepared pnpm 11.22.0 executable directly. The /opt/node.../bin/pnpm Corepack shim attempts a latest-version registry lookup when the candidate has no packageManager field and is therefore forbidden for network-isolated execution. Full mode copies the image-bound read-only pnpm store into the unique writable work root before a fresh install because pnpm 11 opens a store-index SQLite database. Static-only mode uses the exact-hash-matched already installed tree without claiming a fresh install.

forbidden_inputs: host ports or host service reuse
native Codex configuration or authentication mounts

source_integrity_protocol.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted path NUL kind NUL mode NUL content-sha256 NUL records
source_integrity_protocol.tracked_set: Stage-0 entries from git ls-files --stage -z; unresolved index stages are rejected. Regular tracked entries use the Git index mode and filesystem content hash.
source_integrity_protocol.gitlinks: Tracked mode-160000 entries are recorded as either empty unmaterialized directories or clean materialized worktrees. A materialized gitlink must have HEAD exactly equal to the top-level index object ID and zero tracked/untracked status; the record hash binds materialization kind plus object ID. Non-directory, wrong-HEAD, or dirty gitlinks fail closed.
before_copy: Compute /code Git HEAD, tree, tracked root, candidate-surface root, and complete per-entry hashes.
after_copy: Exact-match work tracked and candidate-surface roots to /code before dependency installation.
source_integrity_protocol.test_baseline: Capture Git porcelain status after the frozen offline pnpm install and before gates.
after_tests: Recompute /code and /work tracked and candidate-surface roots.
Require /code unchanged, /work tracked bytes unchanged, /work nonignored candidate surface unchanged, and Git status equal to the test baseline.
Write the added/changed and removed/resolved source-status record lists even when both are empty.
source_integrity_protocol.generated_outputs: Storybook static output, Playwright output, JSON, JUnit, traces, logs, and receipts are directed to /artifacts; ignored node_modules/dist/cache remain confined to /work.

service_target_fingerprint_protocol.normalization: Parse the URL, require the service-specific protocol, clear username, password, and fragment, serialize with URL.toString(), then SHA-256 hash the UTF-8 bytes. Host, port, path, and query remain part of the fingerprint.
service_target_fingerprint_protocol.admission_binding: The security-owner lifecycle receipt and MRW_DATABASE_TARGET_SHA256 must exact-match the computed DATABASE_URL fingerprint. Redis and Elasticsearch fingerprints are recorded, with raw URLs and credentials omitted.

ordered_gates.command: Run all 19 package.json check:* scripts backed by Node contract/audit scripts; browser-backed check:graph-runtime-pixel-gate and check:runtime-visual remain covered by the complete Playwright gate, not duplicated here.
pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.storybook.config.ts --workers 1 --reporter line,json,junit --output /artifacts/.../storybook-test-results

Require stub /healthz, backend /api/v1/health, and backend /api/v1/health/deep to return success.

ordered_gates.command: pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --workers 1 --reporter line,json,junit --output /artifacts/.../frontend-e2e-test-results

static_skip_contract.validation: Current-byte source review and Playwright --list collection establish only an expected inventory of 112 tests with no static skip among the ten restored agent-chat cases. PASS_COMPLETE_NO_SKIPS requires the runner to parse the executed full Playwright JSON report, find exactly 112 tests, and find an empty skipped-title set. Any missing test or conditional or environmental skip fails the gate.

failure_policy.gate_execution: Static gates are attempted in order even if an earlier static gate fails. The complete browser suite runs only after admitted backend and stub readiness; inability to establish that environment is BLOCKED or FAIL, never PASS.
failure_policy.service_cleanup: Runner waits after SIGINT, then SIGTERM, and finally SIGKILL if needed, targeting only the backend and stub child processes it created; failure to observe child exit is recorded as an error.
failure_policy.work_cleanup: No automatic removal; the unique /work projection and /artifacts receipts remain for audit.
failure_policy.source_drift: Any tracked-byte, candidate-surface, or Git-status drift fails the run and is listed explicitly.

pass_definition: All nine ordered gates complete with exit 0 in full mode. Static-only mode replaces the fresh-install gate with the exact image-frozen dependency projection gate and completes that gate plus lint, typecheck, 19 named checks, build, and both Storybook gates.
The ordered result gate IDs exact-match the mode's planned IDs; missing, duplicate, or reordered gates fail the run.
The complete main Playwright report contains exactly 112 tests.
The complete main Playwright report contains zero skipped tests.
The /work tracked and nonignored candidate surface is unchanged after tests.
The /work Git status is unchanged from the post-install test baseline.
The result is bound to the exact preview, image, internal network receipt, environment admission, database target fingerprint, and database sequence lease.
current_blockers: A fresh persistent exact-candidate manifest and materialized preview do not yet exist; attempt6 is not reusable.
A fresh Linux image bound to current pnpm inputs and a fresh internal network negative probe do not yet exist; the predecessor image and network are rejected by the runner.
Exact backend lifecycle admission for the fresh preview, image, security owner, and redacted database target is not yet supplied.
Shared database sequence lease and seeded FRONTEND_E2E_PROJECT_KEY must be assigned by the fresh security owner; the 90-upsert target remains UNKNOWN.

pre_execution_observations.package_static_validation: Node syntax, JSON parse, runner hash binding, nine ordered gate IDs, and 19 unique named static checks are checked without launching the runner. Playwright --list reports 112 collected main tests, and current-byte source review finds zero static skips among the ten restored agent-chat cases; these are collection/source observations only, with execution_observed=false and no PASS claim.

docker_start_probe.observed_state: Two owned network-none probes remained Docker State=created with Pid=0 and no stdout for more than 60 seconds; the root-gate run was independently waiting at the same boundary.
docker_start_probe.cleanup: Owned Docker client PIDs 70276 and 71625 were terminated; owned containers friendly_hawking and distracted_joliot were removed. No application, test, browser, backend, or shared-service process started.
docker_start_probe.ownership_boundary: No shared PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, monitoring, buildkit, or other agent-owned process/container was changed. Main coordination owns further Docker-start diagnosis.
